pokedexEntries.go: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

pokedexEntries.si: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

pokedexEntries.cr: This POKéMON’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets a hold of into bits.

pokedexEntries.rs: SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This POKéMON flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

pokedexEntries.dp: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

pokedexEntries.pt: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.

pokedexEntries.y: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

pokedexEntries.oras: Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This Pokémon flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

pokedexEntries.su: It uses its wings to adjust its body temperature. Otherwise, its metal body would become too hot and melt in the heat of battle.

pokedexEntries.mo: Once it has identified an enemy, this Pokémon smashes it mercilessly with pincers hard as steel.

pokedexEntries.us: Its body is like steel. Its tough, heavy pincers are more suited to smashing enemies than grabbing them.

pokedexEntries.um: Once it has identified something as an enemy, it will continue beating them with its steel-hard pincers until there’s nothing left but scraps.

pokedexEntries.sw: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor’s body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

pokedexEntries.sh: Though its body is slim, Scizor has tremendous attacking power. Even Scizor’s muscles are made of metal.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

pokedexEntries.la: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.
